summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new HR module (shifts, geo-fence, late fines, overtime, salary advances, auto-checkout, aadhaar, salary slip, notice period). 14/14 backend HR test cases pass. Frontend: geo-fence card, Fine/OT column, staff portal late chip, salary-slip rows (Overtime/Late fines/Advance/Net) and advance-modal 'after the 15th' toast all work. Two frontend gaps found: (1) required data-testid attributes on the Edit Staff shift-section are MISSING even though the UI fields are present & working; (2) staff card in admin /staff page does NOT show the required shift chip (10:00–21:00 · OT ₹100/hr).

minor.issue: Uses StaffIn schema which requires name/role/phone; partial updates (send only aadhaar/shift fields) return 422. Frontend workaround: always resends full staff row. Consider a StaffPatchIn for partial updates OR document that clients must merge before PUT.

ui_bugs.issue: Staff card does NOT render the shift chip '10:00–21:00 · OT ₹100/hr' required by the FE spec. Currently only shows role, phone, commission, login-active label + action buttons. Notice badge could not be verified (Priya is not serving_notice; toggle needs to be saved to test).

ui_bugs.component: Staff.jsx Edit modal — SHIFT, ADVANCE & COMPLIANCE section
ui_bugs.issue: Required data-testids are MISSING: staff-shift-section, staff-shift-start, staff-shift-end, staff-overtime-rate, staff-max-advance, staff-notice-days, staff-aadhaar, staff-serving-notice, staff-last-working-day. All the underlying inputs ARE present and functional (visually confirmed) — just untagged, which blocks automation.

input type=number has attributes min=1, max=5000, STEP=100. HTML5 validation rejects any value that isn't 1 + 100*n (e.g. 100, 500, 1000 are all blocked; only 1, 101, 201, ..., 4901 pass). Users trying to give ₹500 or ₹1000 will hit browser-level 'Please enter a valid value' before the request is even sent. Change to step=1 (or step='any').
